plan.melodySummary: The melody travels from bright Trumpet through warm Flugelhorn, dips into Trombone and Tuba for the bridge, and returns to Trumpet for the final shout chorus, with each hand-off marked by a new textural color. The dynamic arc builds from a relaxed mp opening through a swelling mid-section to an ff climax at mm.16-20, then resolves back to a warm mf close.

sections.label: Phrase A (Head)
sections.notes: State the tune at mf with a relaxed swing, dotted-eighth+sixteenth pairs, lean on off-beats; imply Cmaj9 and ii-V color into m.4.

sections.label: Phrase A' (Restatement)
sections.notes: Take over the melody warmly at mf-f, swing hard, brush the blue ♭3 and ♭7 as approach tones over the G7 measures; Trumpet answers with short syncopated licks above you.

sections.label: Phrase B (Turn to Bridge)
sections.notes: Carry the line at f with a broad swaggering swing, glissando into accented weak beats; sit over F13 and Am9 with a bluesy ♭7, building intensity toward the climax.

sections.label: Bridge / Climax (Shout)
sections.notes: Full ff shout-chorus: bright, brassy, heavily syncopated with dotted-eighth+sixteenth kicks; nail the =B natural in m.17 as a leading blue note over C7, drive the ii-V (Dm7-G7) into m.20 as the peak.

sections.label: Final Phrase (Resolve)
sections.notes: Ease back to a warm mf, relaxed swing, tapering the energy; add a ♭7 on the F-G7 turnaround in m.23 and settle onto a plush Cmaj9 in m.24.

Trumpet.instruction: Lead voice for the head and the ff shout climax; play with a bright edge, hard swing, and syncopated off-beat accents. When not on melody, punch short muted stabs and blue-note fills between the melody phrases, never sustaining.

Flugelhorn.instruction: Warm, rounded counterpart to the Trumpet; carry the restatement and the resolving close at mf-f with lyrical swing. Elsewhere weave a legato countermelody with ♭3/♭7 blue inflections, giving space around the lead.

Trombone.instruction: Take the bridge-approach melody with swaggering glissandi at f; otherwise deliver short syncopated comping stabs (extended 7/9/13 voicings) with rests between, and add tailgate blue-note fills under peaks.

Tuba.instruction: Walk a steady quarter-note bass line throughout, chromatic passing tones and ii-V approach notes connecting each chord; keep it buoyant and swung, occasionally dropping to the ♭7 for a bluesy pull.

Bassoon.instruction: Provide inner-voice comping and rhythmic support: short syncopated chord stabs and off-beat kicks reinforcing extended harmonies (9ths, 13ths, ii-V insertions), leaving breathing rests between hits rather than holding pads.
